limitations: Bounded semantic review of 41 supplied gaps only; no whole-video CT or audiovisual completion claim.
All 57 supplied sheets were successfully displayed; each thumbnail is scaled480x270 and is not native evidence.
96 native1920x1080 extractions were actually displayed. Extraction receipt lists100 candidates; four undisplayed candidates are not counted as visual reads.
Native frames were decoded sequentially from source frame0 using installed cv2; source SHA-256 freshly matched manifest. Native extracts are JPEG quality95 derivatives, not original encoded frames.
SAMPLED_BRACKET intervals retain uninspected intervening frames; semantic ownership does not certify every frame or every minor motion/graphic onset.
EXACT_NATIVE means relevant adjacent boundary frames were displayed; it does not imply all interiors were displayed.
No original audio listened; no financial truth verification or claims about creator intent.
Neighbor labels are interpreted from supplied before/after visual samples; NEW means a distinct composition absent from those neighbors, not proof absent from all existing ledgers.
No usage/credit indicators were exposed to this bounded child; root retains session coordination.
